name: Introserv Dobrepolje/Cesta DCH network listing
notes: Very weak location evidence: IP2Location maps 2a06:f940:40:: / AS203466 Introserv d.o.o. to Cesta, Dobrepolje and classifies the usage as Data Center/Web Hosting/Transit. Introserv's own site confirms it is a Slovenia-based hosting company offering dedicated servers, VPS, cloud storage and colocation across multiple data centers, but its corporate address is Ljubljana and no public source confirmed a physical Dobrepolje data-center facility or capacity.
